mechanism: Amphetamine increases sympathomimetic effects (tachycardia, hypertension) which may be exacerbated in patients with vancomycin-induced nephrotoxicity or electrolyte abnormalities, and both agents can cause CNS stimulation.
action: Monitor cardiovascular parameters, renal function, and electrolytes; counsel on amphetamine-related stimulant effects; consider alternative ADHD medications if significant renal impairment develops during vancomycin therapy.
